decisions.text: Use compact, offset, individually tappable card faces for workers, microbes, prey and adaptations so their names and biomass remain visible without expanding the viewport; exceptionally large attachment stacks scroll inside their own stack area.
Include the owner as P1/P2 on compact stacked cards because a worker may belong to the other player while appearing over its target.
Isolate each slot's stacking context so hover transforms cannot change the hit order of overlapping hand cards; this fixes the portrait tap failure reproduced by Playwright.
Honor CardDef.art paths in card faces and closeup thumbnails while continuing to accept built-in icon slugs in the existing art helper.
